Can the 2,615kg Lotus Eletre X really take down a Ferrari?!
Mat’s got his hands on the all-new Lotus Eletre X!
It’s a hybrid version of Lotus’s high-performance SUV, and he’s going up against one of the most popular performance SUVs around - the Ferrari Purosangue!
However, that’s not all. Whoever loses the initial race will then face a ‘proper’ performance car: a Lamborghini Huracan Performante!
So let’s take a closer look at the stats…
